changeSet.author: alexander.stanik@htw-berlin.de
changeSet.comment: Enforce that a user can be linked to at most one tenant per project, and that an email can be used by at most one tenant per project. Both columns are nullable, so partial (filtered) unique indexes are used to exclude NULLs from the uniqueness check. Replaces the now-redundant plain indexes idx_tenant_user_fk and idx_tenant_email_lookup.
